proof_structure.termination: Each recursive call receives a list of strictly smaller length. Length is a natural number (well-founded). Therefore terminates.
proof_structure.sorted: By induction: merge of two sorted sublists produces a sorted list (merge takes the smaller head at each step).
proof_structure.permutation: By induction: no elements are created or destroyed. Split produces sublists whose multiset union equals the input. Merge produces output whose multiset equals the multiset union of its inputs.
